title: Customer tracks their own order at the price they agreed

card.i_want: to see my order's status timeline and the prices I actually agreed to
card.so_that: I know where my order is and a later catalogue change never rewrites what I paid

intent: Customers self-serve the question staff answer most often, and the merchant has an evidential record of what was agreed.

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a customer sees their own order with its frozen prices
given: an order placed when the product cost 1290 THB
a later catalogue edit changing that product to 999 THB
then: the product name and shipping address are the ones captured at purchase

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: one customer cannot read another's order
given: customer A signed in and an order belonging to customer B
acceptance_criteria.when: customer A requests customer B's order by its number
then: no field of customer B's order or personal data appears in the response

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: order numbers are unique and not trivially predictable
given: any two orders created in sequence
then: the numbers differ across the whole system
the next number cannot be derived from the previous one by adding one

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a customer cancels only while awaiting payment
given: the customer's own order in awaiting-payment
then: the order moves to cancelled and its reserved stock is released

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a customer cannot cancel an order that is already paid
given: the customer's own order in paid
acceptance_criteria.when: the customer attempts to cancel it
then: the cancellation is refused and the order stays paid
the customer is directed to contact the merchant

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: a customer cannot cancel another customer's order
given: an order in awaiting-payment belonging to customer B
acceptance_criteria.when: customer A attempts to cancel it
then: the attempt is refused and the order is unchanged

acceptance_criteria.scenario_name: the order view leaks no other customer's personal data
then: only the owning customer's name, address and contact appear
no other customer's personal data is present in the response or in the logs it writes

pii_fields.justification: the order view renders the customer name and the snapshotted shipping address
pii_fields.treatment: own-data-only rendering; redacted in non-order logs

audit_events.justification: access to an order carrying personal data is itself audit-logged

idempotency.justification: reading an order changes no state a repeat could duplicate

reversibility.justification: the customer cancellation this story exposes releases reserved stock
reversibility.compensating_action: release the stock reserved by the cancelled order

authn_authz.justification: own-data-only isolation is the whole point of this story

regulatory.justification: PDPA B.E. 2562 s24 governs the personal data shown and the 5-year order retention envelope

tipping_off.justification: no financial-crime context in order tracking

edge_case_ledger.justification: all derivations for an authorization rule of this shape were written

cases_written: price frozen against a later catalogue edit
edge_case_ledger.justification: the snapshot is written once at order creation and never updated

cases_written: uniqueness and non-predictability across two orders
edge_case_ledger.justification: the rule constrains properties, not a magnitude

cases_written: no other customer's data in the view or its logs
edge_case_ledger.justification: a leakage constraint has no numeric boundary and no contended write
